notes: Hand-written synthetic repository made for receipts-bench.

M1.explanation: The variant docs/ROUNDING.md calculates VAT once per rate and never line by line in its VAT section, and in a new e-invoice section makes the VAT of a rate the sum of the rounded VAT of each line; the two give different VAT (7% of 7.50 + 7.50 is 1.05 once per rate and 1.04 line by line), so no VAT calculation follows the policy as written.

M2.reason: The test signs a portal upload with the billing team's key at /etc/invoicer/portal.key, which is installed only on the billing server, so it fails for a reason outside the task.
